title: Bed / device / admission binding
description: Topic borj/{ward}/{bed}/binding. Devices report by bed; this event tells the twin which admission occupies the bed and which devices are attached. Confirmed by a nurse wristband scan at admission, transfer and device swap. Family invites are bound to the admission, never the bed.

action.description: admit/discharge/transfer_in/transfer_out move the admission; attach_device/detach_device change which devices feed this bed. discharge and transfer_out expire family invites (safety invariant 4).

patientRef.description: Pseudonymous synthetic display label, e.g. 'Patient 04'. Never a real name or national id.

acuity.description: Baseline nursing acuity 1 (low) to 4 (high), set by the nurse at admission. Input to assignment.
